cost.canonicalSource: existing Candidate A and LONG integration cost contract

designOnly.when: G or weak absolute after-cost evidence plus PIT high-vol/reversal or tail concentration supports objective mismatch; document conditional rationale, not claim redesign proven superior.

diagnosis.A_C: Require primary minimum clusters/timestamps, multiple fixed horizons positive adjusted Selector-Random CIs, positive absolute net CI, compatible balance/tail diagnostics; absent outcomes always prevent unconditional full-population claim.
diagnosis.D: PIT high-vol concentration and paired observed-path MFE AND absMAE uplifts; descriptive range association only.
diagnosis.E: Negative PIT prior30 median and positive gross observed rebound; state whether after-cost evidence is weak.
diagnosis.F: Available30 full net mean>0 but both positive-top1 and positive-top5 excluded means<=0; outcome-conditioned descriptive.
diagnosis.G: No monotone net deciles and no consistent positive terminal IC across predeclared horizons; distinguish weak association from negative association.
diagnosis.H: Use only if informative qualified primary fails to support reliable economic edge; not a proof of zero alpha.
diagnosis.I: Any required sample/pairability/identifiability gate unmet. Preserve missingness uncertainty; no forced classification.

pathSemantics.entry: first saved regular-session 5m OPEN at or after selector decision plus intended delay; missing first eligible bar fails closed; no same-bar future HIGH/LOW
pathSemantics.excursions: gross relative to immediate OPEN, MFE=max(0,high return), MAE=min(0,low return); earliest tied bar; zero excursion has timing null
pathSemantics.fixedHorizonAnchor: selector decision wall clock; exact completed close; same AM/PM continuous session; positive holding interval required
pathSemantics.missing: no fill, no interpolation, no zero imputation; full path must contain every expected regular 5m slot; sparse observed-minute bars accepted as existing reference marks and counted
pathSemantics.sessionEnd: same date final regular 5m CLOSE: 15:00 before 2024-11-05, 15:30 thereafter; no auction repair; actual regular bars only across lunch
pathSemantics.timing: minutes from decision; first matching 5m bar interval [start,end]; endpoint is a 5m upper bound, never precise first-hit time; lunch is elapsed wall time not trading time
pathSemantics.zero: gross reference 0 at decision, no economic trade/PF/net inference

premeasurementClarification: Initial Phase A session-end calendar label excluded lunch-time decisions although original v1 permits next regular OPEN. Observed path counts and full5 intersections were unaffected. Correct this label and preserve existing Immediate semantics before NEW v2 outcome calculation; original artifacts retained.

primary.calendar: Fixed horizons remain in one AM/PM continuous session; session end preserves existing Immediate baseline: first regular OPEN at/after decision (11:30 decision may use12:30 OPEN), then same-date regular final CLOSE15:00 before2024-11-05 else15:30. No auction repair. Positive holding interval required.
primary.estimand: Session-equal mean of timestamp-equal original Top5 arithmetic net terminal returns, and same-timestamp Selector minus baseline contrast, conditional on both original full Top5 endpoints observed.
primary.fullPopulationTarget: Original fixed Top5 across all structurally eligible timestamps. Missing endpoints leave this target NOT_IDENTIFIED; complete-case CI does not resolve missing-outcome bias.
primary.noLatentFill: No fill assurance, no next available close, no carry-forward, no interpolation, no zero imputation. Missing first regular OPEN fails closed.
primary.terminalObservability: Immediate first regular 5m OPEN and exact horizon completed CLOSE required; internal missing bars do not invalidate two observed endpoints.
primary.unit: sessionDate -> decisionTimestamp -> exactly five ORIGINAL members

priorExposure: V1 economic results already exposed in prior completed work. Phase A new calculations used availability only; v2 is retrospective Development diagnostics, not confirmatory unseen evidence.

random.repeatNull: NOT_APPLICABLE: repeating draws would not identify missing quotes; preserve prior exact baseline membership and seed.

score.MFE_MAE: Only complete intervening regular paths, separate metric sample counts.
score.deciles: Rank full eligible universe by saved score BEFORE outcome availability at each timestamp; average ranks and ceil(10*percentile).
score.rankIC: Spearman per timestamp, average timestamps by session then cluster CI; constant outcome vectors unavailable.
score.sampleChanges: Horizon-specific universe outcomes not interpreted as longitudinal changes for identical rows.
score.source: Existing deterministic PIT reconstruction + frozen weights; exact identity verified; no training.
score.terminal: Immediate OPEN to exact CLOSE; internal missing bars irrelevant for terminal.

secondary.commonTerminalRows: Separately retain original events with observed endpoints at ALL predeclared horizons up to60/90/120; freeze these evaluator cohorts, compare only shared timestamps, label observation-conditioned; unavailable rows remain in master ledger.
secondary.interpretation: No MAR/IPW assumption, no causal or survivor-unbiased claim, no unconditional alpha from this contrast.
secondary.membership: All 3800 rows per arm retained, with missing-status ledger; never rerank, replace, redraw, or filter membership on future availability.
secondary.missingCounts: Record original/observed/missing denominator for each arm and timestamp including zero-observed timestamps; no arbitrary 3-of-5 gate.
secondary.observedMemberContrast: At the same calendar-eligible timestamp compute each arm mean over observed ORIGINAL member endpoints when defined in both arms, then average timestamps within session and sessions equally. This is explicitly observation-conditional descriptive, never substituted for full Top5 performance.
secondary.path: MFE/MAE/timing/giveback/first-hit require complete intervening regular bars; use exactly v1 definition; no endpoint-to-path imputation.

statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni 95% bootstrap intervals across 7 fixed-horizon primary Selector-Random contrasts; session end and secondary CIs pointwise descriptive.
statistics.pointEstimate: session equal; timestamp equal within session; original5 equal within timestamp for primary
statistics.serialSensitivity: Circular moving blocks of 5 ordered sessions, 10000 replicates, same fixed seed, secondary robustness. Does not prove independence across dates/symbols.

tail.concentration: symbol selection frequency HHI; exclude three most frequent symbols descriptively, no rerank; session top/bottom5 contribution
tail.moments: population skewness and excess kurtosis; outlier sensitive; null if variance=0
tail.peakAfterEndpoint: full-day peak minus earlier endpoint is NOT post-peak giveback; post-peak giveback only when peak bar end <= endpoint
tail.tailExclusion: ceil(fraction*all evaluable rows) largest strictly positive net rows, capped at positive count; worst tail analogous negative; fractions 0.01,0.05; tie break event ID; report removed contribution and remaining mean
tail.winnerCondition: reached threshold anywhere through SESSION_END on a completely observed path; terminal at each horizon separately; future-conditioned description only
